room_rent.note: Room Rent, Boarding, Nursing Expenses up to 1% of Sum Insured per day

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges up to 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on every claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern Treatments capped at 50% of Sum Insured; Room rent and ICU also sub-limited

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible; optional deductible of ₹25,000/₹50,000/₹1,00,000/₹2,00,000 can be opted

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for all illnesses except accidents

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability and HIV/AIDS; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions including cataract, hernia, ENT disorders, varicose veins, etc. subject to 24-month waiting period

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18); not covered under this policy

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days from date of discharge

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list of day-care procedures provided in Annexure III

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by an insured is explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: Listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of Sum Insured

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-payable consumables in Annexure II; consumables cover not available

global_cover.note: Medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/half-yearly/quarterly payment; 15 days for monthly installment mode

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period applicable on new policies only, not on renewals

portability.note: Portability to same product of other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines

notable_exclusions: Treatment outside India, domiciliary hospitalisation, organ donor expenses, maternity, STDs, stem cell storage, ART for HIV, OPD treatment, convalescence
optional_riders: Co-payment waiver (waives mandatory 20% co-pay); Deductible option (₹25k/₹50k/₹1L/₹2L aggregate deductible)
